title: Wilkes Fixed Anchor Profile Registry
objective: Represent the Wilkes gravity-anomaly root as a versioned centroid-and-uncertainty ensemble bound to the root icosahedral face centre.
negative_results: The placeholder centroid (~66.5S, 135E) is a CONVENTIONAL OPERATOR_SELECTION, not a measured gravity-anomaly centroid.
Uncertainty is never collapsed to a point: zero / non-positive-definite / asymmetric covariance is refused (refuse_point_uncertainty).
Multiple defensible candidate centroids are returned as an ensemble rather than selecting the prettiest downstream map.

claims.statement: The Wilkes fixed anchor is a versioned centroid-and-uncertainty ensemble whose selected centroid direction binds to one icosahedral face centre.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public placeholder constants only; no private reads, no personal names or paths.
